description: Lunar dates derived from published lunar-anchored public holidays. Each Gregorian date is taken from the cited holiday list; the lunar date is the traditional rule that holiday follows (e.g. Visak Bochea = ១៥កើត ខែពិសាខ). These records are independent of the calculation engine and are used to verify it.
